step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram displays a serverless machine learning inference and retraining workflow for Tapestry. 1. The web application runs as a Docker container on AWS ECS, utilizing Amplify Framework for rapid deployment, Cognito for authentication (SSO), and Pinpoint for user site analytics. 2. Web requests requiring image analysis pass from ECS through API Gateway, which triggers a serverless Lambda function. 3. Lambda orchestrates multiple downstream actions: invoking a GPU-optimized EC2 instance running a live Flask model container for inference, persisting user request images into S3, and interacting with an Aurora database. 4. S3 routes newly collected data to the data science DEV environment, forming a feedback loop for retraining models and redeploying them into production.
